chapter_title: Concerning the Ad[vent] of the Apostle.

spiritual_reading.full_translation:
Know, my beloved: every heavenly emissary who is sent into the lower degree of life works as one who cultivates states of mind. The communities he gathers and orders are not always in a condition to receive the same things; for there are appointed states for reception, and other states in which reception is not possible. Therefore he discerns the proper state for each implantation of truth and good, knows when instruction should be begun, when it should be moderated, and when it should be brought to completion; and he watches over what has been begun until it advances from first reception into full readiness for use.

If one were to attempt to implant truths within a community whose state does not yet admit them, he would be engaged from the outset in labor that cannot then yield its intended effect; for he would be striving to awaken living understanding before the proper state of reception has been formed. Yet when a fitting state returns in its order, and what has been implanted comes to the point of being brought forth in deeds, then the worker comes into open operation and gathers what has matured into actual use. Likewise from the beginning he labors that the goods of love may come to life within the community; he guards them, arranges them into order, and brings them toward maturity; and when they are perfected for use he leads them forth into outward acts.

In this way, long before an emissary is manifested within the lower degree, he is prepared in interior elevation: he forms within himself the pattern of the community he is to serve, sets it in readiness for reception, and releases it from domination by merely outward life and from the enslaving power of corporeal desire by establishing it first in higher freedom.

For once he turns himself to that service, in that very moment he begins the work of tending and ordering it until it reaches the state in which it can be brought forth into effect; and he labors likewise until the goods that are to proceed are made ready.

This is how the emissaries have acted from the beginning of the ordering of the human race: before anything is brought into ultimate manifestation, it is first made free and established in the interior degree.

But when the community is brought into ultimate life, then the emissary turns himself toward it in that lower degree and immediately begins to elevate it by means of interior truth, so that it may be raised into a fuller state. He remains in the lower degree for as long as that community’s state calls for his presence, according to the time in which its reception is being brought to maturity. When the state is completed, he is withdrawn from the lower degree and leaves behind the form of the community as an organized recipient; yet he does not abandon it, but continues to assist it by interior presence and aid. Whoever afterward departs from merely outward life into a more interior state becomes for those who remain a support and a leader by virtue of the truth and good he has received. Such a one goes before others in the way of ascent, except those who have fixed themselves in corporeal life and will not be led. He becomes for the willing a helper and a guardian; and he does not seize authority by concealment, but waits until the community itself is ready for a change of state. When that change is accomplished and the community is perfected, he is then raised with it into the state of glory, and at last he comes into joy and rest in the completion.

This is like the gladness of a mind when it gathers the uses it has brought forth; or like the satisfaction of understanding when it returns from exploration with abundance, enriched by orderly acquisition.

When an emissary is withdrawn from the lower degree, he and the community he has formed remain conjoined in interior life; for every emissary continues with his own organized reception in the higher degree. For the process of producing uses from love through truth does not cease: while early uses are being brought into act, new beginnings are simultaneously being generated within; and there is no point at which the living recipient is left empty of what can be brought forth. Instead, as soon as one series of uses is completed, another series is initiated in its place; what is being perfected is gathered into act, and what is yet tender is preserved and carried forward, so that the whole may be in perpetual increase. Therefore there is no interval in which the work of regeneration is without labor; and the only cessation is when the intended gathering of truth into use has been accomplished for that state, and the later goods have likewise been advanced to their own completion.

So it is with the emissaries: when one is raised into interior elevation, and he and his community depart from the lower degree, at that same moment another is sent into it to another community to be ordered and served. Yet first he forms within himself the pattern of that community in the higher degree; and when the time comes, he also turns himself toward the lower degree and is made manifest there, and he liberates the community and rescues it from the domination of sinful corporeal life.

But when a community is stripped of living reception and its uses are removed, it is left without the ability to bring forth good.

Yet when a community is brought into ultimate manifestation, the state arrives in which souls may be redeemed: the time when truths are made ready to be gathered into deeds.

He disclosed to me hidden arcana withheld from lower states and from successive stages of understanding: the arcanum of interior and exterior degrees; the arcanum of wisdom and of falsity; the arcanum of temptation and spiritual combat, and of vast upheaval—the struggle that falsity spreads around to overwhelm. Afterward he disclosed how wisdom subdues falsity, and how through the conjunction and separation of good and evil in ultimate states the ordered system of this created domain was established.

He opened my understanding also to the way higher receptacles were formed to carry and preserve what is from heaven, so that the goods and truths of wisdom might be separated and cleansed within the created domain; and conversely how rejected residues of perverted love and falsified understanding are cast down into the lowest state. He instructed me in the arcanum of the first formation of the human—the initial pattern of the spiritual person—and in the arcanum of the turning of the understanding toward self-derived knowing apart from love, by which interior sight is altered and begins to see from a different ground.

paragraph_translations.connection: OPENS the chapter’s teaching by establishing the law of appointed states for reception and fruition.
paragraph_translations.notes: The named months function as ‘appointed states/times’ of reception and fruition; their specific distinction is unclear beyond ‘not always present’.

paragraph_translations.translation: If one were to attempt to implant truths within a community whose state does not yet admit them, he would be engaged from the outset in labor that cannot then yield its intended effect; for he would be striving to awaken living understanding before the proper state of reception has been formed. paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the principle by contrasting premature instruction with instruction timed to maturity and use.
paragraph_translations.notes: Some phrases are corrupt in the source (gaps/brackets); sense is recovered by parallelism between truth-to-use and good-to-acts.

paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS from timing in the lower degree to pre-temporal preparation in the higher degree.
paragraph_translations.notes: The clause about ‘journeys below to the heights’ is internally conflicted; rendered as a movement of preparation in interior elevation.

paragraph_translations.translation: For once he turns himself to that service, in that very moment he begins the work of tending and ordering it until it reaches the state in which it can be brought forth into effect; and he labors likewise until the goods that are to proceed are made ready.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES the preparation theme by describing active ordering once the mission is taken up.
paragraph_translations.notes: The two-stage labor is preserved: first bringing truth to effect, then bringing goods to readiness.

paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the teaching into a universal law of orderly formation from within to without.
paragraph_translations.notes: ‘Moulding of humanity’ is taken as the general ordering of human spiritual development.

paragraph_translations.notes: The source is highly tangled here; ‘truth him’ and several bracketed segments are unclear. Rendered by the consistent thread of state, maturation, withdrawal, and continued conjunction.

paragraph_translations.notes: The image of perpetual fruiting is translated into unceasing generation of uses; the ‘winter/summer’ alternation is treated as alternation of states.

paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS to a negative case: deprivation and barrenness.
paragraph_translations.notes: Very brief image; translated as loss of reception and uses.

paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS from barrenness to the appointed state of redemption and gathering into use.
paragraph_translations.notes: The ‘cereal ripening’ becomes truth ready for embodiment in life.

paragraph_translations.notes: Named figures (‘gods of light’, ‘Adam’) are translated by function: higher goods/truths and the first formed human pattern; the ‘tree of knowledge’ becomes self-derived knowing apart from love.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Strong coherence through ¶3–¶12 as a single teaching on ordered states of reception, maturation into use, interior preparation, and succession of emissaries. ¶20 and ¶23 re-anchor the cycle with a warning and a return to redemption timing. ¶24–¶25 shift into a catalogue of revealed arcana; the voice remains compatible but broadens from church-ordering to cosmological doctrine. The main stumbles come from textual corruption in ¶4, ¶6, and especially ¶9, where several clauses are grammatically broken; the spiritual line can still be sustained by preserving the consistent sequence of states, liberation, withdrawal, and continued conjunction.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential opening: the teaching proceeds by functional analogy (apostles ~ farmers; churches ~ seasonal months), not by jurisdictional lists. No narrative break; months serve as states/times of receptivity.
findings.evidence: Text teaches by how seasons function: "apostles … resemble farmers"; churches "are like Parmuthi and Paophi" because "[they] occur not in all the months … Rather, the season [is appointed] for it alone" and the farmer "know[s] … the time" to crop/tend. The spiritual reading notes this as an opening law of "appointed states for reception and fruition" and only flags that the month-distinction is not fully explained—an interpretive limitation, not a textual intrusion.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty from damage/gaps, not a voice shift. The paragraph continues the same functional farming/gardening analogy but is fragmentary, producing the reader’s ‘recovered by parallelism’ move.
findings.evidence: Heavily bracketed losses: "now that farmer ⟨p.10⟩ [has not yet reached] Parmuthi"; "[before its season, it will not become] cereal"; "involved from the beginning [in planting]"; "Even the gardener from the beginning [he shall take]"; "and he [of his vineyard]". The spiritual reading explicitly: "Some phrases are corrupt … sense is recovered by parallelism"—the stumble is due to lacunae, not an administrative overlay.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty: syntactic/semantic conflict likely from corruption or faulty stitching, but still within correspondential substrate. The ‘journeys below to the heights’ phrase is internally contradictory, matching the reader’s note.
findings.evidence: Text: "Also the way [an apostle is sent] many years before [he appears in] the world, as he journeys below to the [heights]"—a directional clash. The spiritual reading: "The clause about ‘journeys below to the heights’ is internally conflicted." Despite this, the content remains functional (preparing/releasing the church-form from bonds of flesh), not administrative governance.

findings.diagnosis: Clean continuation of the same correspondential process-teaching (states, tending, making free ‘above first’). No intrusion; narrative flows directly from ¶6 into the ‘law’ statement in ¶8.
findings.evidence: Text sustains process by function: "begin … tend … it reaches Parmuthi … harvest"; then generalizes: "apostles … from the beginning of the moulding of humanity … [formed above first] … make it free above, first." The spiritual reading treats ¶7 as continuing preparation and ¶8 as the universal law; no ‘doesn’t fit’ signals and no rank/jurisdiction language.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty with probable composite/garbled transmission inside a largely correspondential passage. The reader’s major stumble arises from broken grammar and duplicated/contradictory clauses, not from an administrative insertion. The underlying narrative (descent, liberation, withdrawal, continued aid) remains consistent.
findings.evidence: The paragraph is tangled: "He shall continue in the world at this time [truth] him"; "corresponding to the season when the world will come to his [until the season will come for]"; "he is raised up from the world [need]"; repeated/stacked clauses: "Still, he [and he is raised up] and he helps"; "he shall not take [the authority] in secret"; "until his church [is able to] change it [then it shall]". The spiritual reading: "source is highly tangled here" and admits multiple unclear segments. Importantly, the ‘authority’ line is not a jurisdictional inventory; it is embedded in the process account (timing of change), so removing it would not clearly improve the narrative as much as repairing the corruption would.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential closure of the first unit: interior analogies (merchant/cargo) and the functional doctrine of unceasing fruiting + apostolic succession by timing (‘at that instant another apostle shall be sent’). No administrative catalogues or territorial ranks.
findings.evidence: Text stays in functional images: "farmer … glad"; "merchant … doubling of his great cargo"; tree always fruiting: "There is not any time the tree is bare of fruit!"; succession by process/timing: "at that instant another apostle shall be sent" and again the ‘forms … made free in the heights … when the season will come … appear in the flesh". The spiritual reading reports "Strong coherence through ¶3–¶12 as a single teaching"—a positive confirmation of substrate continuity.

findings.diagnosis: Likely seam-loss rather than insertion: these paragraphs read like preserved fragments from a longer transition (negative case → redemption timing) but remain in the same correspondential voice. The jump is structural (missing intervening text), not a foreign administrative block.
findings.evidence: Abrupt re-entry at high paragraph numbers (¶20, ¶23) with minimal connective tissue suggests missing material. The images remain functional: "Like a tree will be plucked … remains behind without fruit"; then: "season arrived to redeem … like the month of Parmuthi that cereal shall ripen." The spiritual reading: "¶20 and ¶23 re-anchor the cycle"—it can be integrated, but the numbering/jump indicates a transmission gap more than an overlay.

findings.diagnosis: A topical shift into a revelation-catalogue (mysteries of depths/heights, light/darkness, conflict, construction of ships, Adam, tree of knowledge). This broadens from ‘advent of the apostle’ into cosmological arcana; however it is not in the administrative (jurisdiction/rank) voice. Best diagnosed as a correspondential/mixed doxographic expansion appended at a seam, not an administrative overlay.
findings.evidence: Catalogue form: "He unveiled to me the hidden mystery … the mystery of the depths and the heights … light and the darkness … conflict … war … tumult"; then further items: "ships were constructed; to enable the gods of light to be in them"; "fashioning of Adam"; "tree of knowledge." The spiritual reading flags the main narrative break: "¶24–¶25 shift into a catalogue of revealed arcana" and notes it broadens away from mission-timing. Because it is not governance-by-jurisdiction (no ranks, stations, authorities over territories), excising as ‘Mani’s administrative layer’ is not justified; it is better flagged as an appended revelatory addendum.
findings.scope: Annotate ¶24–¶25 as an appended revelation-catalogue expanding the chapter from apostolic/seasonal process teaching into cosmological mysteries (depths/heights, light/darkness, conflict, ships of light, Adam, tree of knowledge).

textual_criticism.summary: 9 findings: ¶3–¶12 are a coherent correspondential substrate on appointed states, maturation, pre-manifest preparation, withdrawal, and succession (no action). The main stumbles in ¶4, ¶6, and especially ¶9 are best explained by textual damage/garbling rather than insertion (no action). ¶20/¶23 likely reflect missing transitional text (no action). ¶24–¶25 form a seam-like appended revelation catalogue (mixed voice, not administrative): recommend annotation (1 block) and no excision.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: Understand, O my beloved ones: All the apostles who are on occasion sent to the world resemble farmers; while their churches, which they choose, are like Parmuthi and Paophi. For, the way Parmuthi occurs not in all the months of the year; nor does Paophi [occur] in all of them. Rather, the season [is appointed] for it alone, as they know [the season of] its vegetables [and] the time they are cropped; also the vegetables and the [and] season; and they tend and ripen the pickings, and they [fruit-bearing] to Paophi.

Of course, now that farmer ⟨p.10⟩ [has not yet reached] Parmuthi; in that, if he will come and sow some corn seed there [before its season, it will not become] cereal. And he shall be involved from the beginning [in planting] a corn seed and toil for it. Yet, when the summer comes each year, and his corn comes to the season of its harvest; then the farmer comes forth and harvests it. Even the gardener from the beginning [he shall take] shall toil for his fruits; and he tends them and he [of his vineyard] and they ripen; and he comes forth and picks them from the tree.

⟨p.11⟩
Also the way [an apostle is sent] many years before [he appears in] the world, as he journeys below to the [heights] makes the form of his church free, and [he releases it from the bonds] of the flesh, whose forms he had made free [from the bonds]

Like the farmer, for when he will [turn to sow] that moment he shall begin [to work and] tend [it, and] it reaches Parmuthi also, he may harvest it [then] toil for the fruits of Paophi [also he shall]

Again, this too is [how] the apostles [have acted] from the beginning of the moulding of humanity [that it is formed above first], as I have told you, that when they [make it] before every thing he shall [make it] free above, first.

Yet, when it [will be] born in the flesh, he shall come down to it and at once [he will release] it in the [world] which comes out from the [heights] is raised up to the greatness. He shall continue in the world at this time [truth] him, corresponding to the season when the world will come to his [until the season will come for] when the season will mature he is raised up from the world [need] and he leaves his church {behind} and goes forth. Still, he [and he is raised up] and he helps and aids his church. Whoever comes out from their body after him, he shall become for them a support and a leader; and he goes on before them [yet he does not abandon it], excepting the others who are set firmly in the flesh. He is the one who will become for them a helper and a guardian; he shall not take [the authority] in secret, until his church [is able to] change it [then it shall] when his church [is perfected] he was raised up after it, and went into the land of glory. And he rejoices and rests at the last [in the consummation]

Like the farmer who shall be glad of heart in [his house, because] he was bringing in (the harvest). Or like the merchant who shall come up from a country with the doubling of his great cargo; and the riches of his trading.

When the apostle will be raised up from the world, he and his church [remain conjoined] for every apostle [remains] in the [heights] Since [upon a] tree, that still is laden with its first fruits [and], and they are picked; they shall propagate other ones there, and they mature to the season to bring them forth. There is not any time the tree is bare of fruit! Rather, instead, those about to ripen as they pick them shall propagate other ones there. When they bear these [fruits; when they pick] them on the tree; they come up and are brought forth upon its branches. They shall pick from it those that mature and ripen. The farmer does not rest at any time from the labour and the pain. At what hour may he cease? When he can finish harvesting the corn in Parmuthi! [when they cast] them in the winter, the fruits of the summer shall [again] grow up and be picked in the month of Paophi.

⟨p.12⟩
The apostles are like this also. Now, when the apostle will be raised up to the heights, he and his church, and they depart from the world; at that instant another apostle shall be sent to it, to another church [to which he shall serve] it [and make free]. Yet, first, he shall make the forms of his church free in the heights, as I have told you. When [the season will come]; again, he too shall come down and appear [in the flesh] and he releases his church and saves it from the flesh [of sin and death]

⟨p.14⟩
Like a tree will be plucked, and the fruits on it taken away. And it remains behind without fruit.
Yet, when the church assumed the flesh, the season arrived to redeem the souls; like the month of Parmuthi that cereal shall ripen in, to be harvested.

He unveiled to me the hidden mystery, the one that is hidden from the worlds and the generations, the mystery of the depths and the heights. He unveiled to me the mystery of the light and the darkness; the mystery of the calamity of conflict, and the war, and the great [tumult], the battle that the darkness spread about. Afterwards, he unveiled to me also: How the light [subdued] the darkness, through their mingling this universe was set up [and overcame]

He opened my eyes also to the way that the ships were constructed; to enable the gods of light to be in them, to purify the light from creation. Conversely, the dregs and the effluent [are cast down] to the abyss. The mystery of the fashioning of Adam, the first man. He also informed me about the mystery of the tree of knowledge, which Adam ate from; his eyes saw.

changes_summary: No changes made. The critic recommended no excisions (Findings 1–7: none) and only annotation for ¶24–¶25 (Finding 8: annotate), which requires no modification of the restored text.
